scoring_justification: Recompute the asymptotic intercept from the agent's finite-size data via linear extrapolation, then compare to the universal value 1 within tolerances; also verify ratio_avg > ratio_typ.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Eqs. 3.1, 3.2: asymptotic ratio limit is 1, with uncertainties ±0.003 for typical and ±0.03 for average.

outputs.description: The agent's computed correlation length ratios for finite-size scaling. The checker will extrapolate ratio_typ vs 1/l and ratio_avg vs 1/ln l to assess convergence to a universal value, and will check structural trends (ratio_avg > ratio_typ, distinct correction patterns).

output_contract.notes: The agent must provide rows for at least L = 5,7,9,11,13,15,17,19,21 and rho = 2,4. Additional values (rho = 1,10) are optional. The checker will internally extrapolate and compare to the known universal value.
